ncdbe7b556f.headline: Investors ask the ombudsman to check what is happening with KTB
ncdbe7b556f.summary: Investors in Bulgaria have requested the ombudsman to investigate documented asset thefts related to Corporate Commercial Bank (KTB).
ncdbe7b556f.why: Corporate governance and asset security issues at KTB affect investor confidence and banking sector stability in Bulgaria.

n171d25f2fd.headline: BNR Exchange Rate. The US Dollar Collapsed After Trump's Latest Speech
n171d25f2fd.summary: The US dollar declined by more than 1% in 24 hours against the Romanian leu, reflecting a significant drop against the euro after a speech by former President Trump.
n171d25f2fd.why: Currency fluctuations impact trade, investment flows, and multinational companies' earnings; the US dollar is a key global reserve currency.

impacts.name: Romanian Leu
impacts.why: Romanian leu strengthened against US dollar amid dollar weakness.

n2c5520d26c.headline: Economists' Warning: Romania Will Borrow More and More Expensively
n2c5520d26c.summary: Romania's projected budget deficit increase this year is expected to raise state loan interest rates and increase costs for Romanian taxpayers.
n2c5520d26c.why: Rising borrowing costs affect government finances and fiscal sustainability, impacting Romania's economic outlook and investor risk perception.
